title: Alizeh's Mod-Pack
description: A fun and optimized Minecraft modpack with adventure, performance, and aesthetic mods.
body:
# Alizeh’s PvP Mod-Pack ⚔️

Alizeh’s PvP Mod-Pack is a fast, smooth, and optimized Minecraft modpack built for players who enjoy competitive PvP gameplay. The modpack focuses on improving performance, reducing lag, and enhancing the overall combat experience while keeping Minecraft fun and responsive.

This modpack includes carefully selected quality-of-life and optimization mods that help improve FPS, responsiveness, and visual clarity during battles. Whether you play Bedwars, Lifesteal, Crystal PvP, SMPs, or practice PvP, this pack is designed to give a clean and enjoyable experience.

## Features
- FPS and performance optimization
- Smooth and responsive gameplay
- PvP-focused quality-of-life mods
- Cleaner visuals and improved combat feel
- Stable and lightweight mod selection
- Better multiplayer experience

## Perfect For
- Bedwars
- Crystal PvP
- Lifesteal SMPs
- Practice servers
- Competitive Minecraft gameplay

## Notes
This is the first public release of the modpack. Future updates may include additional PvP improvements, visual enhancements, and more optimization features.

Thank you for using Alizeh’s PvP Mod-Pack ✨
